title: Project/shared package.json test scripts
description: Required npm script names for project/shared package.json. Checks use the test:* namespace; build is separate. Use test:eslint (never test:lint). test:alint is required (FS presence). test:format must be prettier --check (not write-only / noop). Shared Prettier is via root prettier.config.mjs (not package.json prettier key) — inventory enforces the file + @sargonpiraev/prettier-config dep. prepare must run lefthook install (hooks after npm ci/install). Optional Playwright lane scripts (test:functional / test:seo / test:analytics / test:cwv) when the project has a webapp/docapp/extapp harness — inventory requires test:cwv when webapp/docapp (or flat-root playwright.config.ts) is present. test:pulumi is always required (Pulumi mocks, or a noop when the repo has no stack). Shipped by @sargonpiraev/eslint-config.

node.description: Portfolio Node soft floor >=22 (align with root .nvmrc = 22 everywhere).

prepare.description: Must run lefthook install so git hooks wire on npm ci / npm install (prefer "lefthook install").

test:cwv.description: Core Web Vitals lab lane (Playwright project cwv). Required by inventory when webapp/docapp or flat-root playwright.config.ts exists. Not part of cheap test:spec.

test:pulumi.description: Always required. Pulumi mocks when pulumi/ exists (assert Webapp/Extapp/Mobapp type tokens). Noop when the repo has no stack.

publishConfig.description: Public packages should set access public + provenance for OIDC Trusted Publishing.
